{"metadata":{"description":"Ward concil is oh-my-pi advisor subsystem ported to DeepSeek Harness — independent reviewer models watch your agent and advise it (nit injects, concern/blocker steer) it also include an auto resume and git checkpoints","id":"gh:1345214461","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-omp-advisor","slug":"AndrasSama/dsh-omp-advisor","topics":["advisor","deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","oh-my-pi","plugin","plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Ward concil is oh-my-pi advisor subsystem ported to DeepSeek Harness — independent reviewer models w"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"atch your agent and advise it (nit injects, concern/blocker steer) it also include an auto resume an"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"nd advise it (nit injects, concern/blocker steer) it also include an auto resume and git checkpoints"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Ward Council"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> **Advisors guide. The ward protects. The model executes.**
>
> *Package name: `dsh-omp-advisor` — "},{"id":"p3s2","text":"the name under which it installs and stores settings.*"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## What is this?"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Your coding agent is good, but on a long session it can tunnel-vision: miss a security hole, claim *"},{"id":"p5s2","text":""done"* before the tests actually pass, or plow ahead after a wrong turn. **Ward Council** gives it "},{"id":"p5s3","text":"a second set of eyes — one or more independent *advisor* models that watch the session in real time "},{"id":"p5s4","text":"and speak up when something matters."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Each advisor reads the transcript as it grows, may investigate your workspace with read-only tools ("},{"id":"p6s2","text":"`read` / `grep` / `glob`), and hands over concrete advice through a dedicated `advise` tool. Advice "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"arrives as a clearly-labeled note the primary agent *weighs* — never a command it must obey:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"You pick each advisor's model from DSH's model list, scope it to specific workspaces, and give it a "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"persona (25 presets included) plus curated domain skills (250 packaged). It is the advisor-watchdog "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"design from can1357/oh-my-pi, rebuilt natively on DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin seams."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## At a glance"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- **Real-time review** — advisors review each new slice of the transcript (per turn, or per step) an"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"d never re-read history twice.
- **Advice, not orders** — notes carry a severity (`nit` / `concern` "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"/ `blocker`) and the guidance *"weigh, don't blindly obey"*; the primary agent decides what to do.
-"},{"id":"p11s4","text":" **Tool-call gate** — optionally turn a finding into a real decision: the host's `tools/pre-execute`"},{"id":"p11s5","text":" waterfall refuses the call before its body runs (`deny`), or holds it for your approval (`ask`). Bo"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"unded, so an advisor can never deadlock the agent.
- **Persistent memory** — advisors recall relevan"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"t lessons into each review and write durable lessons back, through pluggable engines (plaintext MD, "},{"id":"p11s8","text":"OpenViking, Hindsight, MisakaNet, mem0, or any MCP server).
- **Git restore points** — side-effect-f"},{"id":"p11s9","text":"ree workspace snapshots at turn boundaries let an advisor recommend a precise, worktree-only rewind."},{"id":"p11s10","text":"
- **Completion gate** — before the agent claims *"done"*, an advisor verifies the original ask is a"},{"id":"p11s11","text":"ctually implemented and demands an honest report otherwise.
- **Resilience** — auto-retry for failed"},{"id":"p11s12","text":" reviews and turns, quota cooldowns, output quarantine; an advisor never blocks your agent.
- **25 p"},{"id":"p11s13","text":"ersonas, 250 skills** — one-click presets from security auditor to web-novel architect, each with cu"},{"id":"p11s14","text":"rated domain skills.
- **Searchable model selector** — the composer's model seat becomes a type-to-f"},{"id":"p11s15","text":"ilter search box (name / id / provider / description), with the reasoning-effort chips preserved in "},{"id":"p11s16","text":"the panel footer. Absorbed from the standalone `dsh-model-search` plugin.
- **Multi-tab settings + l"},{"id":"p11s17","text":"ive monitor** — General / Advisors / Workspaces / Memory / Monitor, plus an optional workspace-scope"},{"id":"p11s18","text":"— General / Advisors / Workspaces / Memory / Monitor, plus an optional workspace-scoped sidebar tab."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Contents"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- How it works — review loop · advice & delivery · tool-call gate · resilience · intervention · rest"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ore points · completion gate · memory · composer model selector · UI
- Install · Configure · Presets"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" · Skills
- Safety model · Development · Attribution & license · Known limitations"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### The review loop"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- **Incremental reviews.** Advisors never see the whole history twice: a cursor over the durable ses"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"sion log renders each new slice (`user/message`, `assistant/message`, `tool/call`, `tool/result`) in"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"to a compact markdown *update* the advisor model reviews.
- **Tiny-delta skip (optional).** With **S"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"kip tiny deltas** set, transcript updates smaller than the threshold are skipped without calling the"},{"id":"p16s5","text":" advisor model — a cheap way to cut advisor traffic on chatty sessions (skipped deltas are not repla"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"del — a cheap way to cut advisor traffic on chatty sessions (skipped deltas are not replayed later)."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- Advisories render as ordinary plugin messages in the conversation (a dedicated advisory card is fu"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ture work).
- Restore points need a git worktree: non-git (and unborn-HEAD) workspaces are skipped, "},{"id":"p18s3","text":"and sparse checkouts/submodules are out of scope for snapshots. A restore keeps files created after "},{"id":"p18s4","text":"the point — deleting them is the model's deliberate judgment call, guided by the advisory.
- Consumi"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"ng `ctx.changeLedger` when dsh-turn-rewind is installed and session-state (seed-replay) rewind are f"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"uture work. The gate's `ask` mode covers human-approval routing for finding-armed calls; general pat"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"tern-based risk approval (e.g. "ask before any `rm -rf`") is still future work.
- No mutating-tool g"},{"id":"p18s8","text":"rants for advisors yet (oh-my-pi's WATCHDOG.yml roster). The two intervention layers — the pre-call "},{"id":"p18s9","text":"**Tool gate** (refuse/hold a call) and opt-in **Blocker intervention** (cancel the running step) — a"},{"id":"p18s10","text":"re what exists today; full WATCHDOG grants remain targeted for a later release behind the DSH approv"},{"id":"p18s11","text":"al flow.
- The gate is a **policy gate, not a sandbox**: it stops a call an advisor objected to, but"},{"id":"p18s12","text":" an advisor is a model and can be wrong in both directions — it may fail to object, and enabling `ni"},{"id":"p18s13","text":"t` or `concern` as a gating severity will hold up ordinary work. `maxDenials` bounds the cost of a d"},{"id":"p18s14","text":"isagreement, not the quality of the judgment.
- No in-session "advisors watching" badge yet; health "},{"id":"p18s15","text":"is visible in the settings Monitor tab and — with dsh-better-sidebar installed — in the sidebar Advi"},{"id":"p18s16","text":"sors tab (status badge included).
- Status panel polls every 5 s while the settings section is open "},{"id":"p18s17","text":"(sidebar tab: 2 s while registered); no push yet. The activity ring is in-memory only (≤100 events, "},{"id":"p18s18","text":"lost on restart) — monitoring, not audit.
- Advisor memory (v0.7.0) still ahead: composing memory wi"},{"id":"p18s19","text":"th restore points (rewind lessons) and the completion gate (compromise records), MCP connection pool"},{"id":"p18s20","text":"ing, a dedicated memory browser, and per-engine write confirmations.
- Web profile UI; other profile"},{"id":"p18s21","text":"s can still configure the namespace by hand."}],"truncated":true}
